designationHistory.name: Colonial National Monument
designationHistory.indexText: Congress provided for Colonial National Monument, to take in Jamestown Island, parts of Williamsburg and the Yorktown battlefield once the President set its boundaries.

authority.citation: Act of July 3, 1930, ch. 837 (Public No. 510, 71st Cong.), 46 Stat. 855

sources.name: NPS, The National Parks: Index 2012-2016 (p. 104), 'Colonial National Monument authorized July 3, 1930'

designationHistory.name: Colonial National Monument
designationHistory.indexText: President Hoover proclaimed the boundaries of Colonial National Monument, including the Yorktown battlefield.
designationHistory.note: The proclamation number was not legible in the scan and is left out.

sources.name: 46 Stat. 3041, proclamation establishing Colonial National Monument (govinfo)
NPS, The National Parks: Index 2012-2016 (p. 104), 'established Dec. 30, 1930'

designationHistory.indexText: Congress renamed Colonial National Monument as Colonial National Historical Park, which includes the Yorktown battlefield.

authority.citation: Act of June 5, 1936, ch. 525 (Public No. 666, 74th Cong.), 49 Stat. 1483

sources.name: NPS, The National Parks: Index 2012-2016 (p. 104), 'redesignated June 5, 1936'
